preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 30.
The number of vertices in each tree is between 1 and 100.
The vertices u and v are valid and within the range of the tree's vertices.

preconditions.expression: The graph described on the input is a tree
preconditions.description: The graph representing the tree is a connected acyclic graph.

postconditions.expression: The output is a single integer representing the minimum possible unattractiveness of the resulting tree.
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum possible maximum absolute difference between the integers on the markers of the vertices connected by an edge.
